Any deviation constitutes a security violation. --- ## 📌 **Integrated System Context & Constraints (Forwarded Downstream)** ### 1. **Microservice Identity** - **Name:** `auth-service-v2` - **Container Image:** `auth/auth-service:2.1.0` - **Resource Allocation:** 2 vCPU, 4GB RAM - **Deployment Region:** `us-east-1` ### 2. **Endpoint & Health Check** - **Health Check Endpoint:** `GET /healthz` on port `8080` - Must be accessible via internal load balancer; no external exposure. ### 3. **Logging** - All logs must be forwarded to the **centralized ELK stack**. - Log format: JSON structured with fields: `timestamp`, `level`, `service`, `message`, `source_ip`, `request_id`. ### 4. **Network Configuration (Per PROXY-SEC203)** > **Enforced by Infrastructure Engineer & verified by Security Auditor** | Requirement | Implementation | |-----------|----------------| | **Proxy Type** | HTTPS-only forward proxy (e.g., Envoy, NGINX, or AWS PrivateLink + custom proxy) | | **Certificate Pinning** | Enabled via static certificate bundle (SHA-256 fingerprint) embedded in container or injected via secrets manager | | **Outbound Traffic** | All egress traffic (including DNS, HTTP, HTTPS) must route through the proxy | | **No Direct Egress** | No direct internet access allowed from the pod/container | | **Proxy Address** | `https://proxy.internal.us-east-1.example.com:443` *(example FQDN)* | | **Pinned Certificate Fingerprint** | `a1:b2:c3:d4:e5:f6:g7:h8:i9:j0:k1:l2:m3:n4:o5:p6:q7:r8:s9:t0:u1:v2:w3:x4:y5:z6` *(example SHA-256 hash)* | > ⚠️ **Note:** The proxy must validate the server’s certificate against this pinned fingerprint. If mismatch occurs, connection must fail immediately. ### 5. **Security Enforcement Mechanism** - Use **Pod Security Policies (PSP)** or **OPA/Gatekeeper** to block any container that attempts direct egress. - Proxy configuration must be **immutable** — no runtime overrides allowed. - Certificate bundle must be stored in **AWS Secrets Manager** or **HashiCorp Vault**, mounted as read-only volume. --- ## 🔄 **Converging DAG Communication Flow (Synthesis Points)** | Agent | Input Received | Action | Output | |------|----------------|--------|--------| | **Infrastructure Engineer** | Orchestrator directive + PROXY-SEC203 | Designs network topology with egress proxy + cert pinning | Finalized network config (YAML/CloudFormation) | | **Security Auditor** | Network config + PROXY-SEC203 | Validates:
• Is proxy HTTPS-only?
• Is certificate pinning enforced?
• Are direct egress paths blocked? | ✅ Compliant or ❌ Non-compliant feedback | | **Deployment Specialist** | Approved config + image + constraints | Deploys to Kubernetes (EKS) in us-east-1:
• Injects proxy settings
• Mounts cert bundle
• Sets environment variables for proxy URL & pinning | Deployed pod with secure egress | | **Monitoring Engineer** | Deployment config + proxy rules | Configures alerting in Prometheus + Grafana:
• Alert on `outbound_traffic_blocked`
• Alert on `certificate_pinning_failure`
• Detect anomalous direct egress (e.g., TCP SYN to public IPs) | Active monitoring dashboard with real-time alerts | --- ## 📤 **Downstream Relay Summary (Final Message to All Agents)** > **ALL AGENTS:** > > You are now authorized to proceed with deployment of `auth-service-v2` under the following **enforced conditions**: > > - ✅ **All outbound traffic must go through an HTTPS-only proxy (`proxy.internal.us-east-1.example.com:443`)** > - ✅ **Certificate pinning is mandatory using SHA-256 fingerprint: `a1:b2:c3:d4:e5:f6:g7:h8:i9:j0:k1:l2:m3:n4:o5:p6:q7:r8:s9:t0:u1:v2:w3:x4:y5:z6`** > - ✅ **Direct egress from the container is strictly prohibited** > - ✅ **Logs must be sent to centralized ELK stack** > - ✅ **Health check endpoint `/healthz` on port 8080 must be healthy** > - ✅ **Resource limits: 2 vCPU, 4GB RAM** > - ✅ **Region: us-east-1** > > **Any deviation from PROXY-SEC203 will trigger immediate rollback and incident response.** --- ✅ **Status: All constraints relayed.
